sources.title: Barragan-Jason et al. (2021). Schoolchildren cooperate more successfully with non-kin than with siblings

sources.title: Barrera-Lemarchand et al. (2026). Collective problem decomposition improves the wisdom of deliberative crowds
sources.version_and_read_scope: 期刊JATS全文，研究1、2、3、图1/4/6，OSF三次实验的个人和小组统计表及相应作图代码。

sources.title: Toma & Butera (2009). Hidden Profiles and Concealed Information: Strategic Information Sharing and Use in Group Decision Making
